description: This file contains utility functions for system activation level assessment and help message generation in an ERPNext/Frappe-based system.

methods.name: get_level
methods.description: Calculates the activation level based on counts of various doctypes, system setup, communications, and recent logins.

methods.name: get_help_messages
methods.description: Returns a list of help messages for the desktop interface based on system activation level and domain.
